# Hypertension Annual Review

> A UK primary-care **annual hypertension review** that records the objective data needed to confirm blood-pressure control and complete a structured yearly review under **NICE NG136** (*Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management*). It captures clinic and home/ambulatory blood pressure, medication and adherence, cardiovascular risk (QRISK), annual bloods (U&E, HbA1c, lipids), urine albumin:creatinine ratio (ACR), lifestyle, and complications.
